scope: in papers about supplements, fortified food, intake or diet

queries.all: (TITLE_ABS:"calcium") AND (TITLE_ABS:supplement* OR TITLE_ABS:fortif* OR TITLE_ABS:intake OR TITLE_ABS:diet*) AND SRC:MED
queries.reviews: (TITLE_ABS:"calcium") AND (TITLE_ABS:supplement* OR TITLE_ABS:fortif* OR TITLE_ABS:intake OR TITLE_ABS:diet*) AND SRC:MED AND (PUB_TYPE:"meta-analysis" OR PUB_TYPE:"systematic review")
queries.trials: (TITLE_ABS:"calcium") AND (TITLE_ABS:supplement* OR TITLE_ABS:fortif* OR TITLE_ABS:intake OR TITLE_ABS:diet*) AND SRC:MED AND PUB_TYPE:"randomized controlled trial"
queries.guidelines: (TITLE_ABS:"calcium") AND (TITLE_ABS:supplement* OR TITLE_ABS:fortif* OR TITLE_ABS:intake OR TITLE_ABS:diet*) AND SRC:MED AND PUB_TYPE:"practice guideline"
queries.retracted: (TITLE_ABS:"calcium") AND (TITLE_ABS:supplement* OR TITLE_ABS:fortif* OR TITLE_ABS:intake OR TITLE_ABS:diet*) AND SRC:MED AND PUB_TYPE:"retracted publication"

rules: Searched every PubMed record in Europe PMC with calcium (calcium) in its title or abstract, in papers about supplements, fortified food, intake or diet; downloaded all reviews, randomised trials and guidelines.
Left out animal studies (MeSH tags, or the title when there are none) and retracted papers.
An outcome counts when its words are in the title.

Reviews: meta-analyses or systematic reviews of randomised trials of giving calcium, with calcium in the title, or in the abstract of a review of several supplements (not reviews of blood levels in observational studies; reviews without an abstract are kept for screening), and not about another group of people (such as sepsis, intensive care or surgery; each outcome's list is in the search definition). Chosen: the three newest meta-analyses (systematic reviews only if fewer than three), plus the most comprehensive one (most trials pooled, read from the abstract). Citations are shown but do not choose.
Newer large trials: randomised trials of at least 1,000 people (read from the abstract) from the year of the newest chosen review on, which those reviews may not include.

Screening: each eligible review's title and abstract was read against the finding's question (who, what was given, compared with what, what was measured) by Claude Code (opus), titles and abstracts only. Only reviews that answer it can be chosen; the others are listed with the reason. The decisions are kept in the repository and have not yet been checked by a clinician.
Overlap: the chosen reviews' reference lists (from Europe PMC) matched against the downloaded calcium trials, measured as the corrected covered area (Pieper 2014, PMID 24581293).
